neighbours.label: right after a marker that sets up the other side of a contrast or an alternative ('the other', 'on the other hand', 'instead', 'can also'), as opposed to matching sentences without one
fire: One parent pays the rent, and the other 40% of the costs falls to the state.
Cakes and sweets, on the other hand, should be kept out of sight.
If, instead, justice is defined as fairness, the argument changes.
The better way to save money instead is to cook at home.
Smoking and poor sleep can also lead to high blood pressure.
Cats, on the other hand, seem to prefer quiet rooms.
Suppose, instead, that the loan is repaid early by the buyer.
Heavy lifting and long drives can also cause back pain.
quiet: One parent pays the rent, and 40% of the costs falls to the state.
Cakes and sweets, as we said, should be kept out of sight.
If justice is defined as fairness, the argument changes.
My favourite way to save money is to cook at home.
Smoking and poor sleep often lead to high blood pressure.
Cats, as you know, seem to prefer quiet rooms.
Suppose that the loan is repaid early by the buyer.
Heavy lifting and long drives regularly cause back pain.

short: after a contrast or alternative marker
notes: The card flags this pole as positional (top peaks cluster at window position 3). In probes the peak token drifted a word or two after the marker ('0', ' should', ' defined', ' is', '.'). The near misses share most of the sentence, so leakage would count against the label.
